subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI startup gzip budget flakes across identical CI builds

question: After current-main repeat builds identify the source of the 3–13-byte spread, should the project preserve the existing policy with a documented headroom adjustment, or change the budget measurement/build inputs to eliminate profile-dependent variance?
rationale: The evidence establishes a real CI gate failure, but choosing between more margin and a measurement/build-pipeline correction sets the long-term performance-budget policy and cannot safely be inferred from one run.

options.title: Measure first, then preserve a bounded margin
options.body: Repeat each production profile on current main and, if generated inputs are equivalent apart from compression variance, update the documented headroom from the observed worst case.

options.title: Eliminate the varying build input
options.body: If asset HTML, chunk membership, compression settings, or profile configuration differs between nominally identical builds, fix that source of variation and keep the performance ceiling meaningful.

recommendation.title: Measure first, then preserve a bounded margin
recommendation.body: Repeat each production profile on current main and, if generated inputs are equivalent apart from compression variance, update the documented headroom from the observed worst case.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged change established the current 313 KiB headroom and its policy rationale.
